items.text: Founding circle: talk with 5 people outside the team who've tried SocialUs
items.how: 3 who run something local, 2 neighbours. 20 minutes each, five questions, no pitch (on the linked page). After each, text Dispatch a voice note; an agent logs it without names. Do Sentry first (2 minutes, below) so their errors aren't invisible.
items.unlocks: Real evidence for every other call, your first stewards, and a second person who can help run it

items.text: Run the F078 report test (closes #220)
items.how:
Phone, socialus.org. You need THREE accounts: your main (owns the Page), a second email, and a third. A Gmail '+' address works as the third, e.g. yourname+two@gmail.com: same inbox, counts as a different member. Sign in on the second and third with the 6-digit code from the email; never use a builder account (they never send notices).
1. Second account: open a Page your main account owns, tap ⋯ → Report this Page, pick Spam (NOT Sensitive content or Threat of harm: those hide at once), type 'TEST', Send. Page stays up.
2. Main account: open You. A courtesy notice about the report is there, and the Page still shows its name and description.
3. Second account again: report the same Page a second time. Nothing changes (the same person twice does not count; a third try says you already reported it). Fine.
4. Third account: report the same Page, Spam, 'TEST'. Now a second member has reported it: the name and description disappear for everyone, the Page stays up, and your main account gets a 'hidden' notice.
5. Undo: in Admin → Reports, restore the Page's words.
Then tell an agent 'F078 test done': it checks the AI shadow row and closes #220 and #486's check.
items.unlocks: Closes web #220, clears the 10-27 photo tripwire, and proves the AI shadow read runs (#486)

items.text: Try notifications on your iPhone
items.how: Safari → socialus.org → Share → Add to Home Screen. Open SocialUs from the Home Screen, sign in, You → Alerts → turn on New posts from Pages I follow → Allow. Follow a Page; when it posts you get one.

items.text: Look at a Page's Products & services on socialus.org and approve the wording
items.how: Open a business Page you own, scroll to Products & services: add one (name, Save), switch it out of stock, remove it. On someone else's Page, try the ⋯ on an item. Search Explore for its name while signed in. Change any words you don't like (listed on PR #920).

items.text: Approve the search-sharing switch and the owner's "what locals searched" card
items.how: On socialus.org: You → Settings → Searches, and the card on a Page you own. Say if a term may show in both lists ("Fits your Page" and "Found nothing nearby"). Wording is on PR #923.

items.text: Turn on reminder emails
items.how: Resend → Domains → add socialus.org and add the DNS records it shows; then GitHub → socialus-web → Settings → Secrets → Actions: add RESEND_API_KEY (your Resend key) and FOLLOW_EMAIL_FROM (SocialUs <reminders@socialus.org>).
items.unlocks: Remind me reaches members by email when they haven't turned on notifications (push reminders already work)

items.text: Decide at 10-27: end or extend the AI shadow window
items.how: Numbers as of 10-19 (production, read-only): 2 reports ever, none since the window opened 10-13; 0 AI reads written; 0 person-vs-AI agreements; 0 of 14 shadow days counted; no recorded test-set run (recall and false-alarm numbers: none, because the key is not in GitHub so CI only validates the set; recording a run is yours: `npm run moderation:eval -- --record` with your key). Check again on 10-27: Admin → Reports → AI readiness panel (recall ≥ 95%, severity-1 recall 100%, false alarms < 10%, 14 shadow days). My recommendation: extend. With almost no reports there is nothing to agree or disagree on; go live only when the panel reads Ready.
items.unlocks: Whether the AI report read can go live (web #486)
